class.name: ItemTouchHelperCallback
class.brief_description: Callback that declares movement flags and handles drag / swipe commits.
class.description:
ItemTouchHelperCallback is the port of [i]ItemTouchHelper.Callback[/i]. Subclass it and override the hooks below: [method _get_movement_flags] declares which directions each holder can be dragged / swiped, and [method _on_move] / [method _on_swiped] apply the change to your data and notify the adapter.
[b]Reorder + swipe example[/b]: [codeblock] class Callback extends ItemTouchHelperCallback: func _get_movement_flags(holder: ViewHolder) -> int: return ItemTouchHelper.make_movement_flags(ItemTouchHelper.UP | ItemTouchHelper.DOWN, ItemTouchHelper.LEFT | ItemTouchHelper.RIGHT)
func _on_move(rv: Object, dragged: ViewHolder, target: ViewHolder) -> bool: my_adapter.items.move(dragged.get_position(), target.get_position()) my_adapter.notify_item_moved(dragged.get_position(), target.get_position()) return true
func _on_swiped(holder: ViewHolder, direction: int) -> void: my_adapter.items.remove_at(holder.get_position()) my_adapter.notify_item_removed(holder.get_position()) [/codeblock]

method.name: _can_drop_over
method.description: Returns whether [code]selected[/code] may be dropped onto [code]target[/code] (default true).

method.name: _clear_view
method.description: Called after the gesture ends to clean up (after the snap-back animation).

method.name: _get_bounding_box_margin
method.description: Returns an extra margin around the candidate target box for drag swaps (default 0).

method.name: _get_move_threshold
method.description: Returns the drag swap threshold as a fraction of the item extent (default 0.5).

method.name: _get_movement_flags
method.description: Returns the drag + swipe direction bits for a holder, usually built with [method ItemTouchHelper.make_movement_flags].

method.name: _get_swipe_escape_velocity
method.description: Returns the velocity that flings the item off screen (default 120.0).

method.name: _get_swipe_threshold
method.description: Returns the swipe commit distance threshold as a fraction of the viewport (default 0.5).

method.name: _get_swipe_velocity_threshold
method.description: Returns the maximum pointer velocity ItemTouchHelper ever reports, in pixels per second (default 800.0). Mirrors Android's [b]Callback.getSwipeVelocityThreshold[/b]: computed velocities are clamped to this range, so a diagonal fling whose axes both hit the cap is not treated as a swipe. Lower the value to accept diagonal swipes more easily; raise it to require straighter movement.

method.name: _is_item_view_swipe_enabled
method.description: Returns whether swiping is enabled (default true).

method.name: _is_long_press_drag_enabled
method.description: Returns whether long-press dragging is enabled (default true).

method.name: _on_move
method.description: Called when the dragged holder crosses a target holder's mid-line during a drag. Move your data and call [method Adapter.notify_item_moved], then return true. The first argument is the [b]RecyclerView[/b] (typed as Object from the script side).

method.name: _on_selected_changed
method.description: Called when a holder is selected / deselected (drag or swipe starts / ends).

method.name: _on_swiped
method.description: Called when a swipe commits (the item slid off screen). Remove the data and call [method Adapter.notify_item_removed]. [code]direction[/code] holds the swipe direction bits ([constant ItemTouchHelper.UP] etc.).
